summary: A Depth subscription, acknowledged at Sahi's 5 levels. A DepthTick with two bids and no asks carries the levels Sahi sent and no padding (two bids, no asks); the next replaces the book (one bid, six asks truncated to five); one with no levels clears it.

deviations.reason: Sahi sent no open interest for this instrument (open_interest, a proto3 optional, is off its ticks); the web publishes oi 0 for it (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload), a number the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out; decisions.md).
The web's alias of oi, sent as 0 with it for an instrument whose ticks carry no open interest; left out with oi (see oi).

web pads each side to five rows of price 0.0 (sahi_mapping.py::_depth_side); docs: buy/sell are the broker's levels; never invent zero prices (decisions.md). The padding is the adapter's own: Sahi's DepthTick carries only the levels holding orders, as repeated best_buys (field 11) and best_sells (field 12) entries with no fixed empty slots (sahi_proto.py:228-231; sahi_mapping.py:99). The desktop keeps every level Sahi sent, up to five.
